jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

About The Role

As Circle expands the customers and payment methods it serves, our fraud exposure grows and changes. We rely on conservative limits and third-party models today, and we are building our own.

As a Senior Data Scientist on Fraud Analytics, you will own the prediction side of our fraud loop. You will turn labels into features and models, measure their accuracy, and shift Circle from vendor scores to in-house models. You will work with Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Risk Engineering, and Compliance.

What You’ll Do

Build and evaluate fraud models for onboarding, login, account changes, and money movement. Target risks include account takeover, scams, money mules, and stolen and synthetic identity.
Evaluate third-party risk signals and design the path from vendor models to Circle models, from shadow mode to production.
Define the label taxonomy and data requirements with Fraud Operations and Risk Engineering, so every event, decision, and outcome becomes training data. This includes the fraud we miss.
Design holdout and exploration sampling to measure false negatives and the rate at which we wrongly block good customers.
Track fraud rate, dispute rate, fraud loss rate, and precision across customer segments. Help set thresholds against an agreed loss budget.
Work with Fraud Strategy to tune thresholds and rules and respond to emerging attacks.
Backtest, monitor drift, and retrain models on Circle’s fraud platform.
Help build AI agent workflows for transaction review, fraud-ring analysis, and rule drafting, and evaluate their accuracy against human labels.

Core Requirements

5+ years in data science or applied ML on fraud, risk, or financial crime
Advanced Python and SQL, and experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, or similar
Experience building models with sparse, delayed, or biased labels, including cold start, reject inference, and chargeback lag
Strong statistics: anomaly detection, graph or network methods, experimentation, and threshold optimization
Experience taking models to production and monitoring them
Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners
Comfort working through ambiguity and limited historical data

Preferred Requirements

Fintech, payments, crypto, or card fraud experience, including chargebacks and disputes
Experience with device intelligence, behavioral signals, or consortium data
Familiarity with blockchain analytics, AML, and KYC
Experience evaluating LLM or agent-based review workflows

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

Base Pay Range: $152,500 - $205,000

We are an equal opportunity employer
. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (Quant Modeling) - TikTok
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The Product Data Analytics Team analyzes a combination of product usage and product performance data to derive meaningful insights that would serve as a guide to better product and decision making for our business leaders.
As a member of the data science team, you will work with diverse and highly collaborative teams of product managers, engineers, and other data analysts to drive product impact. You will be working on exciting and challenging projects, and convert the insights into real changes, for both new initiatives and scaled products. You are a self-starter who is excited about data, excels in product logic thinking, clear communication, and brings distinctive problem-solving skills and impeccable quantitative modeling experience.

As a Data Scientist, you will be working on designing and monitoring core metrics, identifying the root causes for metric movements through deep dive into the models. The role will cover a wide range of model-driven solutions to deliver superior business outcomes through research and analyses. In particular, this role will leverage the causal structure of user behavior, identify trends and opportunities for user growth and great ecosystem, and guide the product team to make best decisions.

Responsibilities
- Leverage data to solve challenging business problems from full-spectrum of product and business lines, using analytical and statistical approaches.
- Build and improve applicable statistical models, e.g. LTV and ROI prediction, to guide user growth-related decisions.
- Initiate model-driven analysis to provide deep insights into various products. Catch the common rule of problems and establish the inter-product analytic paradigm.
- Work with Product, Operations, Engineering and cross-functional teams to drive product development through analytic, statistical, and algorithmic expertise
- Design, run and analyze A/B experiments to inform and execute the product strategy, and ultimately improve the product and support business decisions.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Statistics, Operations Research, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics).
- 2+ years of experience in statistical modeling (Regression, Classification, Clustering, etc.) and machine learning (deep learning), and experience in user-level modeling
- Ability to conduct rigorous analysis and communicate conclusions to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Proficiency in SQL, Python/R

Preferred Qualifications
- Solid communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with internal teams in a diversified environment
- Passion for the Internet industry and data analysis.
- Self-starter with the ability to acquire an in-depth understanding of the relation between data and user experience/product growth.

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Details

Job Description:

Why Join Us

Join a team shaping the future of AI on Intel platforms. You will work on cutting-edge technologies that accelerate Large Language Models, Generative AI, and other advanced AI workloads on next-generation Intel GPUs. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with experts across hardware architecture, compilers, runtime systems, and AI frameworks while developing skills that span the full AI software stack. Your work will have direct impact on delivering industry-leading AI performance and enabling the next generation of AI applications.

Intel is seeking a Senior AI Systems Software Engineer
to drive optimization strategy and technical leadership across the AI software stack. In this role, you will lead the development of high-performance software solutions that accelerate AI inference workloads, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and emerging machine learning applications on Intel GPU platforms.

You will work across software, compilers, runtimes, frameworks, and hardware architecture teams to deliver breakthrough AI performance and influence future product direction.

What You’ll Do

Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:

Lead optimization initiatives for AI inference workloads on Intel GPUs.
Define and drive performance optimization strategies across compilers, runtimes, and GPU kernels.
Architect software solutions that improve scalability, efficiency, and performance.
Profile, benchmark, and analyze complex AI workloads to identify system bottlenecks.
Influence hardware and software co-design decisions through performance characterization and workload analysis.
Drive cross-functional technical initiatives spanning architecture, compiler, framework, and runtime teams.
Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across projects.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify future optimization opportunities.

Behavioral Traits That We Are Looking For

Demonstrates exceptional technical judgment and the ability to solve complex, high-impact challenges.
Thinks strategically across the software and hardware stack, identifying opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and efficiency.
Leads through influence, building alignment and driving outcomes across cross-functional organizations.
Communicates effectively with both technical and business audiences, translating complex concepts into actionable insights.
Operates with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, driving initiatives from strategy through execution.
Uses data, experimentation, and measurable results to inform decisions and guide technical direction.
Develops and elevates talent through mentorship, collaboration, and technical leadership.
Brings an innovation mindset and a passion for advancing the future of AI computing.

Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life.

See Intel Benefits for more details.

Qualifications

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Note

For information on Intel’s immigration sponsorship guidelines, please see

Intel U.S. Immigration Sponsorship Information

Minimum Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field with 5+ years or experience. Or a Master's degree in the same field with 3+ years of experience or a PhD in the same filed with 1+ years of experience.

Your Experience Described Above Must Be In The Following

Experience in software development, AI systems, or performance engineering.
C++ software development and debugging
Experience with performance analysis, profiling, and optimization of compute-intensive applications.
Experience with modern neural network architectures and their execution on hardware accelerators.

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

GPU architectures, AI accelerators, or parallel computing systems.
Experience optimizing end-to-end AI inference workloads in production environments.
Familiarity with AI inference frameworks such as llama.cpp, vLLM, OpenVINO, PyTorch, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or similar technologies.
Experience with graph compilation and optimization technologies such as MLIR, LLVM, TVM, XLA, or related compiler frameworks.
Experience with GPU programming models such as Vulkan Compute, OpenCL, SYCL, CUDA, HIP or equivalent technologies.
Knowledge of neural network optimization techniques, quantization, kernel fusion, memory optimization, and performance tradeoffs.
Experience across multiple layers of the AI software stack, including:
AI inference runtimes and serving frameworks
Graph compilers and optimization frameworks
GPU kernels and performance-critical compute code
Experience contributing to open-source software projects is a plus.

Why Join Intel

You'll help shape the future of AI computing by solving some of the industry's most challenging performance problems. Working alongside leading experts in AI, GPU architecture, compilers, and systems software, you'll have the opportunity to influence next-generation technologies that power AI at scale.

Job Type

Experienced Hire

Shift

Shift 1 (United States of America)

Primary Location:

US, California, Folsom

Additional Locations:

US, California, Santa Clara, US, Oregon, Hillsboro

Posting Statement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

Position of Trust

N/A

Benefits

We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel.

Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $149,750.00 - 275,580.00 USD

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Work Model for this Role

This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications will be accepted until 01/31/2027.

About The Role

Our architect team is organized into four domains that together make the platform work for customers: Platform Advantage (why Salesforce, why now), Emerging Tech & UI Innovation (agent execution and dev tooling), Data & AI Excellence (data, semantics, and AI context), and Governance & Trust (identity, security, and audit). This req can land in any of the four, based on where your deepest expertise fits and where the team has the most need at the time of hire.

Across all four domains, the DNA is the same: you lead with the customer's business and technical problem, not a product pitch, you're fluent across Salesforce and its alternatives, and you stay engaged through execution so the work actually lands, not just the recommendation.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day will concentrate in one or two of the following, depending on domain placement:

Agent Architecture (Platform Advantage / Governance & Trust): orchestration, agent-to-agent interaction, state and memory, guardrails, testing.
MCP & Capability Architecture (Platform Advantage / Emerging Tech): exposing business capabilities for agents to discover and act on, not just raw objects.
Data 360 & Semantic Architecture (Data & AI Excellence): unified customer data, semantic layers, and the context AI needs to be useful.
Headless & Composable Architecture (Platform Advantage / Emerging Tech): APIs, headless experiences, and composable extensions of Salesforce beyond the standard UI.
AI-Assisted Development (Emerging Tech): coding assistants, reviewing AI-generated work, dev lifecycle and quality practices.
AI Governance & Security (Governance & Trust): identity and permissions, data access, agent authority, human-in-the-loop controls, audit.

Regardless Of Domain, You'll Also

Work collaboratively across multiple pre and post sale teams.
Align C-suite stakeholders around a shared view of a business problem and map it to a capability someone can act on.
Help resolve platform-fit ambiguity for customers facing conflicting internal recommendations or a troubled prior rollout.
Name ambiguity and route it explicitly to the right domain rather than letting unclear work default to whoever's in the room.

What We're Looking For

Required

5+ years in enterprise or solutions architecture, with direct experience influencing senior technical and business stakeholders.
Experience with AI tooling to build solutions, learn new skills, and be more efficient with your job.
Deep, credible expertise in at least one of the six focus areas above, deep enough to be the final word in a room, not conversational familiarity.
Fluency across the Salesforce platform or at least one major alternative / adjacent technology relevant to your focus area.
A track record of staying engaged through delivery, including recovering stalled or politically stuck work.
B.S., M.S. or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering or MIS

Preferred

Working knowledge of a second focus area above, enough to know when to hand off rather than overreach.
Experience untangling a failed or stalled enterprise rollout (data, MDM, platform, or AI) for a customer.
Strong visual communication skills for architecture storytelling.

Domain Placement

Final domain assignment (Platform Advantage, Emerging Tech & UI Innovation, Data & AI Excellence, or Governance & Trust) is determined during the interview process based on demonstrated depth and current team need, not fixed at the time of posting.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $148,190 - $198,170 annually There is a different range applicable to specific work locations. In California and New York, and select cities in the metropolitan areas of Boston, Chicago, Seattle, and Washington DC, the base pay range for this role in those locations is $162,960 - $217,980 per year. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

jobs.title: Lead Applied Scientist, Document Understanding
jobs.description:
Job Description

This role sits within the applied science function. You will own the design, development, and production deployment of document understanding systems that directly power Westlaw, PracticalLaw, and CoCounsel. The problems are real, the scale is large, and the expectation is shipped, reliable, measurable impact.You will work across semantic chunking, document enrichment, knowledge graph construction, and synthetic data generation for complex legal, tax, and accounting content. Multiple product teams depend on what this function delivers.

Key Responsibilities

Design and deploy semantic chunking models for lengthy, non-uniformly structured legal documents with adjustable granularity across use cases
Build document enrichment systems using legal and customer-defined taxonomies
Develop LLM-based knowledge graph construction pipelines that extract and link citations, entities, and legal concepts across diverse legal content
Lead knowledge distillation efforts to compress large models into latency-constrained, production-ready SLMs
Design evaluation frameworks — component-level and end-to-end — using expert annotation and synthetic data
Own technical decisions on architecture, chunking strategy, classification approach, and knowledge extraction methods
Partner with engineering on delivery, reliability, and scale across multiple product lines
Provide technical input to senior leadership on AI strategy and roadmap
Mentor applied scientists and ML practitioners on the team

Required Qualifications

PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, or a related field
8+ years of industry experience building and scaling document understanding, information extraction, knowledge graph, or applied NLP solutions
Demonstrated expertise across the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including model development, evaluation, optimization, distillation, and production deployment
Strong Python programming skills with hands-on experience in PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and DeepSpeed
Track record of publishing research in leading conferences such as ACL, EMNLP, ICLR, NeurIPS, SIGIR, KDD, or equivalent
Proven ability to mentor technical talent and drive measurable business impact through production-ready AI systems
Experience translating advanced research into scalable, high-performing products and services
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders alike

Hands-on Production Depth Required In

Document layout analysis and semantic chunking beyond fixed-size or paragraph-based methods
Hierarchical, multi-label document classification with domain-specific and customer-defined schemas
Entity recognition and linking, relation extraction, citation parsing, and knowledge graph construction from unstructured text
LLM-based information extraction, few-shot and multi-task learning, and post-training
Knowledge distillation, model compression, and SLM deployment under latency constraints
Synthetic data generation and annotation workflow design
End-to-end evaluation framework design for document understanding

Preferred Qualifications

Legal document understanding, legal IE, or legal AI experience
Complex document structures: nested hierarchies, cross-references, non-uniform formatting
Retrieval or QA systems over large document collections
RAG and agentic workflows in enterprise settings
Knowledge graph frameworks for legal or enterprise applications
AzureML or AWS SageMaker

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role.

Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. jobs.description:
Practice - AIA - Artificial Intelligence and Analytics

About AI & Analytics:

Artificial intelligence (AI) and the data it collects and analyzes will soon sit at the core of all intelligent, human-centric businesses. By decoding customer needs, preferences, and behaviors, our clients can understand exactly what services, products, and experiences their consumers need. Within AI & Analytics, we work to design the future—a future in which trial-and-error business decisions have been replaced by informed choices and data-supported strategies.

By applying AI and data science, we help leading companies to prototype, refine, validate, and scale their AI and analytics products and delivery models. Cognizant’s AIA practice takes insights that are buried in data and provides businesses a clear way to transform how they source, interpret and consume their information. Our clients need flexible data structures and a streamlined data architecture that quickly turns data resources into informative, meaningful intelligence.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior AI Solution Architect to lead the design and implementation of enterprise-scale AI, Generative AI, and agentic AI solutions. This role will define scalable AI architectures leveraging Microsoft Azure, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Large Language Models, RAG, and multi-agent frameworks. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on AI engineering expertise with enterprise architecture, data platform, integration, security, and responsible AI capabilities. This position requires a strategic technology leader who can translate business goals into secure, production-ready AI solutions and guide cross-functional teams through enterprise AI adoption.

In This Role, You Will

Define enterprise AI strategy, reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and governance standards aligned with business and technology objectives.
Architect Generative AI and agentic AI solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Agent Service, LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, and vector databases.
Design multi-agent systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Establish orchestration patterns for tool calling, memory management, context engineering, autonomous workflows, multi-agent coordination, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Design modern data platforms using Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
Architect batch and real-time data pipelines, data products, metadata, lineage, data quality, master data management, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native solutions using AKS, Azure Functions, API Management, Cosmos DB, Azure AI Search, Event Hubs, Service Bus, and Azure SQL.
Establish Responsible AI, model governance, evaluation, observability, explainability, security, privacy, and AI risk-management frameworks.
Lead architecture review boards, technical workshops, solution assessments, proofs of concept, modernization programs, and executive stakeholder discussions.
Mentor architects, engineers, data scientists, and product teams while driving reusable AI platform capabilities and engineering best practices.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

10+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Architecture, Data Engineering, or Software Engineering.
5+ years of hands-on experience delivering AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or advanced analytics solutions.
3+ years of experience implementing enterprise Generative AI, RAG, LLM, or agentic AI solutions.
Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, API Management, Azure AI Search, and related cloud services.
Strong experience with Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake Storage, and modern data engineering patterns.
Hands-on knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, MCP, or comparable AI orchestration frameworks.
Strong understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, knowledge graphs, AI agents, tool calling, memory, and multi-agent coordination.
Experience designing API-first, event-driven, microservices, and cloud-native integration architectures for enterprise AI platforms.
Strong knowledge of AI security, Zero Trust, identity management, data privacy, model governance, Responsible AI, and regulatory compliance.
Proven experience leading cross-functional teams, architecture governance processes, and executive-level technology discussions.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Scientist.

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Scientist within the NYU Grossman School of Medicines Ronald O. Perelman Department of Emergency Medicines Research Division. This Research Scientist will work in the Lab of Dr. Kelly Doran on her portfolio of NIH-funded studies examining the intersection of housing and health, with a focus on homelessness and substance use. The Labs studies include community-partnered clinical trials, quantitative research (including survey research and analysis of large, linked administrative datasets), and qualitative research.

The Research Scientist will lead work on multiple existing and potential future studies. Examples of the Labs active research portfolio includes studies examining implementation of overdose prevention interventions in supportive housing, and substance use and other health impacts of pandemic homeless hoteling initiatives.

The Research Scientist will be critical for ensuring successful implementation and dissemination of the Labs studies. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, adept in the conduct of research, and have significant research experience and knowledge at the intersection of homelessness and substance use. The Research Scientist must be able to function proficiently and independently in overseeing quantitative data collection, data management, and analysis as well as project management and writing (manuscripts, reports, abstracts, etc.). Qualitative research skills and experience are a bonus. While being able to work autonomously, the Research Scientist must also be adept at maintaining good communication with the study PI, Program Manager and other research staff, and study partners spanning community organizations, governmental agencies, and people with lived experience of housing insecurity. The position is based in Manhattan, with some remote work allowable.

Job Responsibilities

Provide scientific and technical leadership for the design and execution of research projects focused on housing and health (primarily homelessness and substance use). Collaborate with faculty investigators and external partners on study design, interpretation, and dissemination.

Oversee analytic activities across multiple studies, working with study biostatisticians, data analysts, and other research staff to ensure on-time completion of high-quality analysis deliverables.

Lead or co-lead manuscript development for peer-reviewed journals as well as reports, presentations, and other dissemination products.

Oversee data acquisition and storage, including coordinating applicable data use agreements and ensuring compliance with funder requirements for data sharing. Set up systems for data quality monitoring and work with research staff to ensure compliance. Ensure high standards for data management, reproducibility, documentation, and research integrity.

Comply with all budget and regulatory requirements. As appropriate, oversee study staff to ensure fulfillment of regulatory requirements including IRB protocols, regulatory binder maintenance, DSMB reports and meetings, etc.

Contribute to grant proposals, including literature review, preliminary analyses, writing, and editing.

Communicate professionally with internal and external partners. Contribute to a positive and respectful work environment and support team morale.

In collaboration with other study staff, help facilitate and develop agendas and materials for regular meetings with co-investigators, the Study Advisory Board, and others.

Understand the big picture and ensure completion of project activities on time and with fidelity to study goals.

Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

To qualify you must have a MS degree and 2-4 years of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Post-PhD training, preferably in an academic medical school research setting. Pre- or post-PhD work in relevant, real-life applied settings (e.g., government, homeless services) also appreciated.

Strong training in trial design, survey research, implementation science, quantitative research using large administrative datasets, advanced statistics, and/or quasi-experimental methods.

Proficiency with qualitative research conducted in a research / academic setting, including basic knowledge of qualitative research methods and qualitative analysis software.

Strong knowledge of research regulatory requirements (IRB, data repositories and sharing, etc.) and ability to fulfill research regulatory tasks without supervision.

Experience implementing statistical analysis plans, data management protocols, and procedures to ensure data security and research integrity.

Knowledge of coding and data management using R, SAS, and/or other statistical analysis software.

Expertise using REDCap for survey design and data collection.

Experience with and skills in supervising and mentoring research staff, students, and others.

Prior experience with complex program

Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

About the Role
We’re looking for an exceptional Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, and customer success. In this role, you’ll work directly with customers to understand complex business challenges, design and build tailored technical solutions, and deploy production-ready systems that deliver measurable impact.

This is an opportunity for a highly technical, hands-on engineer who thrives in fast-paced startup environments and enjoys solving problems that don't have predefined answers. You’ll operate across the full development lifecycle—from understanding customer requirements and prototyping solutions to integrating systems, deploying applications, and iterating based on real-world feedback.

Key Responsibilities
Work directly with customers:
Collaborate with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, identify technical challenges, and translate requirements into actionable engineering solutions.
Build and deploy production systems:
Design, develop, test, and deploy software applications and integrations tailored to customer needs.
Solve complex technical problems:
Diagnose challenging issues across APIs, data pipelines, application architectures, and existing customer infrastructure.
Develop AI-powered solutions:
Apply modern AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), to build practical applications that address real-world business problems.
Own end-to-end implementation:
Take solutions from discovery and rapid prototyping through production deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
Integrate with customer systems:
Build robust integrations with third-party APIs, enterprise platforms, databases, and customer-specific infrastructure.
Operate with urgency and autonomy:
Make sound technical decisions, prioritize effectively, and deliver results in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments.
Collaborate cross-functionally:
Partner with product, engineering, and leadership teams to communicate customer insights, influence product direction, and improve the platform.
Translate feedback into product improvements:
Identify recurring customer challenges and help turn them into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
Drive measurable outcomes:
Ensure deployed solutions deliver tangible business value through improved workflows, increased efficiency, automation, or other customer-defined success metrics.

Qualifications
3+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in a high-growth startup or similarly demanding technical environment.
Strong programming skills in one or more modern languages, such as Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, or Java.
Experience designing, building, and deploying production-grade software applications.
Solid understanding of APIs, system integrations, databases, and modern software architecture.
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical problems and deliver practical solutions under tight timelines.
Experience working directly with customers, clients, or cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements and communicate technical concepts clearly.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous requirements with minimal supervision.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
A high degree of ownership, adaptability, and willingness to work across the full engineering lifecycle.
Willingness to work full-time on-site in San Francisco, CA.

Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Field Engineer, or Customer Engineer in a technically demanding environment.
Experience working at a top-tier startup known for engineering excellence, rapid execution, and a high talent bar.
Familiarity with AI/ML systems, LLM APIs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or AI application development.
Experience deploying software into enterprise customer environments and integrating with complex technical infrastructure.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure, as well as containerization and deployment workflows.
Experience with data engineering, ETL pipelines, SQL, and working with large or complex datasets.
Experience building prototypes quickly and turning successful experiments into maintainable production systems.
Comfort balancing hands-on coding with customer discovery, technical presentations, and implementation planning.

What Success Looks Like
Deliver high-quality technical solutions that solve meaningful customer problems.
Move quickly from customer discovery to working prototypes and production deployments.
Build strong relationships with customers by understanding their needs and delivering reliable results.
Identify opportunities to turn customer-specific implementations into reusable product capabilities.
Contribute actionable customer feedback that helps shape product and engineering priorities.
Maintain a high standard of technical quality while executing with speed and ownership.

Work Environment
This is a full-time, on-site position based in San Francisco, CA. You’ll work closely with customers and internal technical teams in a fast-paced startup environment where initiative, engineering excellence, and measurable outcomes are highly valued.

jobs.title: PKPD & PMx  Data Scientist – PK Data Delivery
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Overview

The PK Data Delivery (PKDD) team is embedded within Global PK/PD & Pharmacometrics and is the quantitative data partner across discovery and clinical development. We deliver high-quality, analysis-ready and model-ready datasets and analytical outputs that enable model-informed drug development (MIDD) decisions.

We are seeking a highly motivated individual with strong programming and clinical data expertise to support PK data delivery, data quality, and process innovation initiatives. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure PK data are collected, transformed, validated, and delivered efficiently to support decision-making throughout the drug development process.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

Collaborate with Data Management, Project Statisticians, Statistical Analysts, PK/PD project leaders, Pharmacometricians, and other cross-functional partners to develop and independently validate PK analysis-ready datasets, PK-related SDTM domains, ADaM datasets, and Tables, Listings, and Figures (TFLs) in compliance with study specifications, CDISC standards, regulatory requirements, and company procedures.

Partner with PMx Leads and PK/PD (clinical pharmacology) Leads from study design onward to anticipate the data requirements of planned PK/PD and population analyses, review data collection strategies, study documents, and clinical trial data throughout the study lifecycle, and identify, communicate, and resolve issues impacting PK data quality, traceability, analysis readiness, and downstream analyses.

Develop and implement innovative R programming, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve efficiency, quality, reproducibility, and scalability of PKPD data delivery processes.

Basic Qualifications

This position may be filled at different career levels. Placement will be determined based on the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, and capabilities demonstrated.

Master's degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

Experience in R or SAS programming.

Experience with clinical trial data structures, clinical data standards, and statistical analysis concepts.

Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT,J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Requirements

This position requires regular onsite presence at the assigned Lilly location (Indianapolis, IN, LCC).

Additional Skills / Preferences

Experience developing SDTM datasets, ADaM datasets, and TFL in a regulated clinical development environment.

Experience supporting PK data readiness activities and developing PK analysis-ready datasets for PK/PD and PMx analyses.

Experience with FDA, EMA, ICH, and CDISC standards and guidelines.

Knowledge of clinical trial processes and drug development.

Experience reviewing study design, data collection strategies, and study documentation to support PK or PK/PD analyses.

Experience using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (e.g., Claude Code) in programming, data review, quality control, or workflow automation.

Strong R proficiency, including package development, reproducible workflows, and version control (Git).

Experience or training in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or clinical research environments.

Exposure to population PK/PD or pharmacometric modeling, including dataset conventions for NONMEM, Monolix, or similar tools.

Strong attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication with scientific and clinical partners.

Success Factors

Ownership & Execution

Demonstrates strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity.

Applies strong logical thinking and problem-solving skills to programming and data-related challenges.

Is self-motivated, accountable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a timely manner.

Adaptability & Learning

Thrives in a fast-paced, high-demand environment and effectively manages competing priorities, evolving project needs, and tight deadlines.

Actively learns new methods and tools, including AI-assisted ways of working, and applies them to real deliverables rather than waiting for dedicated training time.

Demonstrates flexibility, works independently with minimal supervision, and willingly steps up to support team priorities when needed.

Collaboration & Impact

Communicates data issues and decisions in terms of their impact on the analysis and the program, so partners can act on them.

Builds productive partnerships across functions and proactively engages stakeholders to advance project goals and business outcomes.

Demonstrates ownership by proactively addressing issues, challenging organizational silos, driving cross-functional alignment, and overcoming obstacles that impact quality, efficiency, or project success.

Shows persistence, courage, resilience, and a results-oriented mindset in addressing difficult or longstanding challenges, making tangible progress, driving complex initiatives to successful outcomes, and continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
About Venn

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect, you are the technical owner of our most complex enterprise deals. You will lead the technical sale from first discovery call through architecture review, security sign-off, proof-of-concept and close, working side by side with Account Executives on strategic accounts.

Our buyers are CISOs, CIOs, IT architects and security and compliance leaders at large, regulated organizations. They are replacing or reducing VDI, locking down contractor and BYOD access, and answering to auditors. You will earn their trust by designing a solution that fits their identity, endpoint, network and compliance stack, and by proving it works in their environment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real influence. You will shape how we run technical evaluations, set the standard for demos and POCs, and bring field insight to Product that changes the roadmap. You are part engineer, part consultant and part storyteller, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in a room of executives.

What You'll Do

Lead enterprise technical discovery. Partner with Account Executives to map each customer's identity, endpoint, VDI, network and data-protection environment, and the business and compliance drivers behind the project.
Architect solutions for complex environments. Design deployments that integrate with Microsoft 365/Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, Google Workspace, existing VDI, VPN and ZTNA, and endpoint and DLP tooling, and document the reference architecture for the customer's review.
Own proofs-of-concept and technical evaluations. Define success criteria with the customer up front, run the POC end to end, and turn the results into a clear business case.
Run security reviews. Lead security questionnaires, RFP and RFI technical responses, architecture reviews and compliance mapping with customer security, risk and legal teams.
Present at every level. Deliver deep technical sessions for engineers and architects, and concise value-led narratives for CISOs, CIOs and other executive sponsors.
Build the technical business case. Quantify value against incumbent approaches such as VDI, VPN and managed devices (cost, user experience, risk reduction) alongside the Account Executive.
Handle competition. Stay current on the competitive landscape and industry trends, and position Venn against VDI, DaaS, VPN, browser isolation and MDM-based approaches in secure BYOD enablement.
Raise the bar for the team. Build demo environments, POC playbooks, battlecards and reusable solution content, and mentor junior Sales Engineers.
Close the loop with Product. Bring structured customer and competitive feedback to Product and Engineering so it informs the roadmap, and make sure customers feel supported from evaluation through handoff to Customer Success.
Represent Venn externally. Speak as a subject matter expert at webinars, conferences and industry events to build awareness and thought leadership.

What You Bring

10+ years in a technical pre-sales role (Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect or similar) at a SaaS or security company, with at least 5 years selling to large enterprise and regulated customers.
A track record of leading the technical side of six- and seven-figure deals with multiple stakeholders, long cycles and formal security review.
Experience running structured POCs with defined success criteria that convert to closed-won.
Strong expertise in end-user computing, Windows environments and virtual desktop infrastructure (Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 or similar), including the limits that drive customers to look for alternatives.
Hands-on experience with identity and access: Microsoft Entra ID/Microsoft 365, Okta and Google Workspace, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, conditional access and MFA.
Solid grounding in networking and secure access: VPN, ZTNA, proxies, DNS and firewalls, and secure browsing.
Working knowledge of endpoint security (EDR/XDR, MDM/UEM), DLP and data-protection controls, and how they behave on unmanaged and contractor devices.
Fluency in compliance and regulatory frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SEC, FINRA and SOC 2, and in how to map product controls to audit requirements.
Comfort scripting and working with APIs (PowerShell, Python or similar) to build demos, automate POCs and troubleshoot in customer environments.
Credibility with technical and executive audiences alike: you can whiteboard an architecture with an engineer in the morning and defend the business case to a CISO in the afternoon.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn technical depth into clear, customer-focused value.
A consultative approach to discovery: you uncover the real problem, not just the stated requirements.
Strong ownership and judgment: you prioritize across several deals, know when to bring in Product or Engineering, and make Account Executives better.
Comfortable traveling to customer sites and events (adjust percentage to your needs).

Nice to Have

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience at a growth-stage company, where you helped build the pre-sales function, playbooks or POC process.
Industry certifications such as CISSP, Microsoft (SC-300, AZ-500, MD-102), Okta, or Citrix/VMware credentials.
Prior experience selling into financial services, healthcare or other regulated industries.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

Competitive compensation and commission opportunities
Equity at Venn
Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits
Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off
The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment, and we look for teammates who do the same.

Overview

About the role

We are seeking a Distinguished Engineer to shape the technical and scientific direction of Intuit Intelligence. You will combine deep expertise in AI science and machine learning with hands-on experience building agents that solve meaningful customer problems.

You will connect research, model development, agent engineering, and production delivery across multiple organizations. Your work will establish reusable foundations for intelligent products and demonstrate where emerging AI capabilities can create durable business value. At least 40% of your time will be devoted to technical contributions, including experiments, prototypes, agent development, evaluation, and production problem-solving.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

Define the long-term AI and ML strategy, connecting scientific advances to customer needs, product opportunities, and production constraints.
Architect and build agents that reason over context, retrieve information, use tools, coordinate workflows, and complete tasks with appropriate human oversight.
Establish reusable approaches for agent orchestration, context and memory management, capability integration, and recovery from failures.
Guide model selection, adaptation, training, and inference decisions using scientific evidence and explicit tradeoffs in quality, latency, and cost.
Build evaluation systems that measure model quality, end-to-end task completion, robustness, safety, and customer value.
Establish production practices for monitoring, experimentation, model and agent lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.
Address difficult challenges in grounding, uncertainty, generalization, permissions, privacy, and reliable execution.
Develop firsthand judgment through research and implementation, advancing promising ideas from experiments into validated product capabilities.
Partner with engineering, product, design, data science, and security leaders; mentor senior technical talent and model responsible agent-driven development.

Qualifications

What you’ll bring

Deep expertise in AI science and ML, including statistical learning, deep learning, experimental design, and rigorous evaluation.
Demonstrated experience building and operating production AI systems and agents that perform consequential workflows.
Strong understanding of foundation models, retrieval, tool use, agent orchestration, and techniques for adapting models to domain needs.
The ability to distinguish improvements in model behavior from improvements in system reliability and customer outcomes.
A record of translating research into scalable products and reusable technical capabilities.
Strong software and systems engineering judgment, with the ability to influence technical direction across organizations.
The ability to explain scientific uncertainty and technical tradeoffs clearly to executive and technical audiences.

AI and agents complete customer tasks with measurable quality and reliability. Scientific advances translate into adopted product capabilities, reusable foundations accelerate delivery, and teams improve customer outcomes while managing operational cost and risk.

new_jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

About The Role

As Circle expands the customers and payment methods it serves, our fraud exposure grows and changes. We rely on conservative limits and third-party models today, and we are building our own.

As a Senior Data Scientist on Fraud Analytics, you will own the prediction side of our fraud loop. You will turn labels into features and models, measure their accuracy, and shift Circle from vendor scores to in-house models. You will work with Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Risk Engineering, and Compliance.

What You’ll Do

Build and evaluate fraud models for onboarding, login, account changes, and money movement. Target risks include account takeover, scams, money mules, and stolen and synthetic identity.
Evaluate third-party risk signals and design the path from vendor models to Circle models, from shadow mode to production.
Define the label taxonomy and data requirements with Fraud Operations and Risk Engineering, so every event, decision, and outcome becomes training data. This includes the fraud we miss.
Design holdout and exploration sampling to measure false negatives and the rate at which we wrongly block good customers.
Track fraud rate, dispute rate, fraud loss rate, and precision across customer segments. Help set thresholds against an agreed loss budget.
Work with Fraud Strategy to tune thresholds and rules and respond to emerging attacks.
Backtest, monitor drift, and retrain models on Circle’s fraud platform.
Help build AI agent workflows for transaction review, fraud-ring analysis, and rule drafting, and evaluate their accuracy against human labels.

Core Requirements

5+ years in data science or applied ML on fraud, risk, or financial crime
Advanced Python and SQL, and experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, or similar
Experience building models with sparse, delayed, or biased labels, including cold start, reject inference, and chargeback lag
Strong statistics: anomaly detection, graph or network methods, experimentation, and threshold optimization
Experience taking models to production and monitoring them
Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners
Comfort working through ambiguity and limited historical data

Preferred Requirements

Fintech, payments, crypto, or card fraud experience, including chargebacks and disputes
Experience with device intelligence, behavioral signals, or consortium data
Familiarity with blockchain analytics, AML, and KYC
Experience evaluating LLM or agent-based review workflows

This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with experts across hardware architecture, compilers, runtime systems, and AI frameworks while developing skills that span the full AI software stack. Your work will have direct impact on delivering industry-leading AI performance and enabling the next generation of AI applications.

Intel is seeking a Senior AI Systems Software Engineer
to drive optimization strategy and technical leadership across the AI software stack. In this role, you will lead the development of high-performance software solutions that accelerate AI inference workloads, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and emerging machine learning applications on Intel GPU platforms.

You will work across software, compilers, runtimes, frameworks, and hardware architecture teams to deliver breakthrough AI performance and influence future product direction.

What You’ll Do

Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:

Lead optimization initiatives for AI inference workloads on Intel GPUs.
Define and drive performance optimization strategies across compilers, runtimes, and GPU kernels.
Architect software solutions that improve scalability, efficiency, and performance.
Profile, benchmark, and analyze complex AI workloads to identify system bottlenecks.
Influence hardware and software co-design decisions through performance characterization and workload analysis.
Drive cross-functional technical initiatives spanning architecture, compiler, framework, and runtime teams.
Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across projects.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify future optimization opportunities.

Behavioral Traits That We Are Looking For

Demonstrates exceptional technical judgment and the ability to solve complex, high-impact challenges.
Thinks strategically across the software and hardware stack, identifying opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and efficiency.
Leads through influence, building alignment and driving outcomes across cross-functional organizations.
Communicates effectively with both technical and business audiences, translating complex concepts into actionable insights.
Operates with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, driving initiatives from strategy through execution.
Uses data, experimentation, and measurable results to inform decisions and guide technical direction.
Develops and elevates talent through mentorship, collaboration, and technical leadership.
Brings an innovation mindset and a passion for advancing the future of AI computing.

Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life.

See Intel Benefits for more details.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field with 5+ years or experience. Or a Master's degree in the same field with 3+ years of experience or a PhD in the same filed with 1+ years of experience.

Experience in software development, AI systems, or performance engineering.
C++ software development and debugging
Experience with performance analysis, profiling, and optimization of compute-intensive applications.
Experience with modern neural network architectures and their execution on hardware accelerators.

GPU architectures, AI accelerators, or parallel computing systems.
Experience optimizing end-to-end AI inference workloads in production environments.

Experience with graph compilation and optimization technologies such as MLIR, LLVM, TVM, XLA, or related compiler frameworks.
Experience with GPU programming models such as Vulkan Compute, OpenCL, SYCL, CUDA, HIP or equivalent technologies.
Knowledge of neural network optimization techniques, quantization, kernel fusion, memory optimization, and performance tradeoffs.
Experience across multiple layers of the AI software stack, including:

These leaders will provide independent, in-IDE technical depth during M&A or investment diligence, while helping build common DeepTech capabilities, models, and infrastructure that portfolio companies can leverage after joining AI Labs.

Lead technical and AI diligence for potential acquisitions and strategic investments. (Formal diligence experience is not required.)
Critically evaluate (by testing, studying, using, and remixing) architecture, models, data strategy, infrastructure, security, scalability, technical differentiation, and technical debt.
Interview and score DeepTech talent.

Partner directly with founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders during diligence.
Identify material technical risks and opportunities and translate them into clear recommendations for AI Labs leadership.
Identify opportunities for portfolio companies to adopt shared AI technologies, evaluation frameworks, infrastructure, standards, and services, only where doing so creates material leverage.
Identify capabilities that should be built once across AI Labs, rather than repeatedly by individual companies, and the technical and nontechnical tradeoffs.
Serve as a senior technical advisor across the AI Labs portfolio without becoming a centralized bottleneck.

Deep understanding of modern AI architectures, models, training/post-training and inference, data, evaluation, infrastructure, production systems, and how technical choices shape product outcomes.
Ability to rapidly understand unfamiliar technical stacks and distinguish true technical differentiation from implementation detail.
Experience working with startup/founder-led engineering teams.
Strong technical judgment combined with deep product taste and pragmatic business thinking.
Experience with technical diligence, DeepTech investing, acquisitions, or startup evaluation is nice to have. (Having shipped differentiated AI/ML products matters more.)

Distill

Bravery without bravado

Job Description

This role sits within the applied science function. You will own the design, development, and production deployment of document understanding systems that directly power Westlaw, PracticalLaw, and CoCounsel. The problems are real, the scale is large, and the expectation is shipped, reliable, measurable impact.You will work across semantic chunking, document enrichment, knowledge graph construction, and synthetic data generation for complex legal, tax, and accounting content. Multiple product teams depend on what this function delivers.

Key Responsibilities

Design and deploy semantic chunking models for lengthy, non-uniformly structured legal documents with adjustable granularity across use cases
Build document enrichment systems using legal and customer-defined taxonomies
Develop LLM-based knowledge graph construction pipelines that extract and link citations, entities, and legal concepts across diverse legal content
Lead knowledge distillation efforts to compress large models into latency-constrained, production-ready SLMs
Design evaluation frameworks — component-level and end-to-end — using expert annotation and synthetic data
Own technical decisions on architecture, chunking strategy, classification approach, and knowledge extraction methods
Partner with engineering on delivery, reliability, and scale across multiple product lines
Provide technical input to senior leadership on AI strategy and roadmap
Mentor applied scientists and ML practitioners on the team

Required Qualifications

PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, or a related field
8+ years of industry experience building and scaling document understanding, information extraction, knowledge graph, or applied NLP solutions
Demonstrated expertise across the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including model development, evaluation, optimization, distillation, and production deployment
Strong Python programming skills with hands-on experience in PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and DeepSpeed
Track record of publishing research in leading conferences such as ACL, EMNLP, ICLR, NeurIPS, SIGIR, KDD, or equivalent
Proven ability to mentor technical talent and drive measurable business impact through production-ready AI systems
Experience translating advanced research into scalable, high-performing products and services
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders alike

Hands-on Production Depth Required In

Document layout analysis and semantic chunking beyond fixed-size or paragraph-based methods
Hierarchical, multi-label document classification with domain-specific and customer-defined schemas
Entity recognition and linking, relation extraction, citation parsing, and knowledge graph construction from unstructured text
LLM-based information extraction, few-shot and multi-task learning, and post-training
Knowledge distillation, model compression, and SLM deployment under latency constraints
Synthetic data generation and annotation workflow design
End-to-end evaluation framework design for document understanding

Preferred Qualifications

Legal document understanding, legal IE, or legal AI experience
Complex document structures: nested hierarchies, cross-references, non-uniform formatting
Retrieval or QA systems over large document collections
RAG and agentic workflows in enterprise settings
Knowledge graph frameworks for legal or enterprise applications
AzureML or AWS SageMaker
