Job Description:

The Data and AI team within Global Payment Solutions (GPS) at Bank of America
is looking for an AI Engineer who is a self-starter, thrives on solving ambiguous problems, and can translate advances in artificial intelligence into scalable, production-ready products.

Who we are:

The GPS Data and AI team drives and powers innovation within the one of the largest payment businesses in the world. We are a team of data scientists and engineers building end-to-end AI and data solutions that operate at scale. We welcome challenging and ambiguous problems because that is where innovation begins. Many of our projects start with "think tank" sessions alongside business teams, where we identify high-impact opportunities and translate them into tangible AI-powered solutions and products.

Our work spans Generative AI, information retrieval, intelligent agents, machine learning, natural language processing, optimization, and predictive modeling, with a strong focus on turning emerging AI capabilities into solutions that create measurable business value.

Representative Projects:

Develop advanced statistical methods to determine the optimal interest-rate or product pricing strategies for clients
Build a Generative AI-powered search platform that enables sales and product teams to access high quality answers to product, servicing, and client related questions
Develop AI models that shift foreign currency conversion “up the payment stream,” reducing reliability on beneficiary banks
Apply advanced NLP techniques to generate near real-time insights into what clients are reaching out to servicing teams about, helping servicing teams anticipate client needs and improve service quality

new_jobs.description:
1167863_RR00126025 Job ID: 1167863_RR00126025

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Scientist.

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Scientist within the NYU Grossman School of Medicines Ronald O. Perelman Department of Emergency Medicines Research Division. This Research Scientist will work in the Lab of Dr. Kelly Doran on her portfolio of NIH-funded studies examining the intersection of housing and health, with a focus on homelessness and substance use. The Labs studies include community-partnered clinical trials, quantitative research (including survey research and analysis of large, linked administrative datasets), and qualitative research.

The Research Scientist will lead work on multiple existing and potential future studies. Examples of the Labs active research portfolio includes studies examining implementation of overdose prevention interventions in supportive housing, and substance use and other health impacts of pandemic homeless hoteling initiatives.

The Research Scientist will be critical for ensuring successful implementation and dissemination of the Labs studies. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, adept in the conduct of research, and have significant research experience and knowledge at the intersection of homelessness and substance use. The Research Scientist must be able to function proficiently and independently in overseeing quantitative data collection, data management, and analysis as well as project management and writing (manuscripts, reports, abstracts, etc.). Qualitative research skills and experience are a bonus. While being able to work autonomously, the Research Scientist must also be adept at maintaining good communication with the study PI, Program Manager and other research staff, and study partners spanning community organizations, governmental agencies, and people with lived experience of housing insecurity. The position is based in Manhattan, with some remote work allowable.

Job Responsibilities

Provide scientific and technical leadership for the design and execution of research projects focused on housing and health (primarily homelessness and substance use). Collaborate with faculty investigators and external partners on study design, interpretation, and dissemination.

Oversee analytic activities across multiple studies, working with study biostatisticians, data analysts, and other research staff to ensure on-time completion of high-quality analysis deliverables.

Lead or co-lead manuscript development for peer-reviewed journals as well as reports, presentations, and other dissemination products.

Oversee data acquisition and storage, including coordinating applicable data use agreements and ensuring compliance with funder requirements for data sharing. Set up systems for data quality monitoring and work with research staff to ensure compliance. Ensure high standards for data management, reproducibility, documentation, and research integrity.

Comply with all budget and regulatory requirements. As appropriate, oversee study staff to ensure fulfillment of regulatory requirements including IRB protocols, regulatory binder maintenance, DSMB reports and meetings, etc.

Contribute to grant proposals, including literature review, preliminary analyses, writing, and editing.

Communicate professionally with internal and external partners. Contribute to a positive and respectful work environment and support team morale.

In collaboration with other study staff, help facilitate and develop agendas and materials for regular meetings with co-investigators, the Study Advisory Board, and others.

Understand the big picture and ensure completion of project activities on time and with fidelity to study goals.

Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

To qualify you must have a MS degree and 2-4 years of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Post-PhD training, preferably in an academic medical school research setting. Pre- or post-PhD work in relevant, real-life applied settings (e.g., government, homeless services) also appreciated.

Strong training in trial design, survey research, implementation science, quantitative research using large administrative datasets, advanced statistics, and/or quasi-experimental methods.

Proficiency with qualitative research conducted in a research / academic setting, including basic knowledge of qualitative research methods and qualitative analysis software.

Strong knowledge of research regulatory requirements (IRB, data repositories and sharing, etc.) and ability to fulfill research regulatory tasks without supervision.

Experience implementing statistical analysis plans, data management protocols, and procedures to ensure data security and research integrity.

Knowledge of coding and data management using R, SAS, and/or other statistical analysis software.

Expertise using REDCap for survey design and data collection.

Experience with and skills in supervising and mentoring research staff, students, and others.

Prior experience with complex program

Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents. At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online.

new_jobs.title: PKPD & PMx  Data Scientist – PK Data Delivery
new_jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Overview

The PK Data Delivery (PKDD) team is embedded within Global PK/PD & Pharmacometrics and is the quantitative data partner across discovery and clinical development. We deliver high-quality, analysis-ready and model-ready datasets and analytical outputs that enable model-informed drug development (MIDD) decisions.

We are seeking a highly motivated individual with strong programming and clinical data expertise to support PK data delivery, data quality, and process innovation initiatives. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure PK data are collected, transformed, validated, and delivered efficiently to support decision-making throughout the drug development process.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

Collaborate with Data Management, Project Statisticians, Statistical Analysts, PK/PD project leaders, Pharmacometricians, and other cross-functional partners to develop and independently validate PK analysis-ready datasets, PK-related SDTM domains, ADaM datasets, and Tables, Listings, and Figures (TFLs) in compliance with study specifications, CDISC standards, regulatory requirements, and company procedures.

Partner with PMx Leads and PK/PD (clinical pharmacology) Leads from study design onward to anticipate the data requirements of planned PK/PD and population analyses, review data collection strategies, study documents, and clinical trial data throughout the study lifecycle, and identify, communicate, and resolve issues impacting PK data quality, traceability, analysis readiness, and downstream analyses.

Develop and implement innovative R programming, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve efficiency, quality, reproducibility, and scalability of PKPD data delivery processes.

Basic Qualifications

This position may be filled at different career levels. Placement will be determined based on the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, and capabilities demonstrated.

Master's degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

Experience in R or SAS programming.

Experience with clinical trial data structures, clinical data standards, and statistical analysis concepts.

Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT,J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Requirements

This position requires regular onsite presence at the assigned Lilly location (Indianapolis, IN, LCC).

Additional Skills / Preferences

Experience developing SDTM datasets, ADaM datasets, and TFL in a regulated clinical development environment.

Experience supporting PK data readiness activities and developing PK analysis-ready datasets for PK/PD and PMx analyses.

Experience with FDA, EMA, ICH, and CDISC standards and guidelines.

Knowledge of clinical trial processes and drug development.

Experience reviewing study design, data collection strategies, and study documentation to support PK or PK/PD analyses.

Experience using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (e.g., Claude Code) in programming, data review, quality control, or workflow automation.

Strong R proficiency, including package development, reproducible workflows, and version control (Git).

Experience or training in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or clinical research environments.

Exposure to population PK/PD or pharmacometric modeling, including dataset conventions for NONMEM, Monolix, or similar tools.

Strong attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication with scientific and clinical partners.

Success Factors

Ownership & Execution

Demonstrates strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity.

Applies strong logical thinking and problem-solving skills to programming and data-related challenges.

Is self-motivated, accountable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a timely manner.

Adaptability & Learning

Thrives in a fast-paced, high-demand environment and effectively manages competing priorities, evolving project needs, and tight deadlines.

Actively learns new methods and tools, including AI-assisted ways of working, and applies them to real deliverables rather than waiting for dedicated training time.

Demonstrates flexibility, works independently with minimal supervision, and willingly steps up to support team priorities when needed.

Collaboration & Impact

Communicates data issues and decisions in terms of their impact on the analysis and the program, so partners can act on them.

Builds productive partnerships across functions and proactively engages stakeholders to advance project goals and business outcomes.

Demonstrates ownership by proactively addressing issues, challenging organizational silos, driving cross-functional alignment, and overcoming obstacles that impact quality, efficiency, or project success.

Shows persistence, courage, resilience, and a results-oriented mindset in addressing difficult or longstanding challenges, making tangible progress, driving complex initiatives to successful outcomes, and continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).

Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is

$90,000 - $195,800

Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

new_jobs.title: Solutions Architect
new_jobs.description:
About Venn

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect, you are the technical owner of our most complex enterprise deals. You will lead the technical sale from first discovery call through architecture review, security sign-off, proof-of-concept and close, working side by side with Account Executives on strategic accounts.

Our buyers are CISOs, CIOs, IT architects and security and compliance leaders at large, regulated organizations. They are replacing or reducing VDI, locking down contractor and BYOD access, and answering to auditors. You will earn their trust by designing a solution that fits their identity, endpoint, network and compliance stack, and by proving it works in their environment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real influence. You will shape how we run technical evaluations, set the standard for demos and POCs, and bring field insight to Product that changes the roadmap. You are part engineer, part consultant and part storyteller, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in a room of executives.

What You'll Do

Lead enterprise technical discovery. Partner with Account Executives to map each customer's identity, endpoint, VDI, network and data-protection environment, and the business and compliance drivers behind the project.
Architect solutions for complex environments. Design deployments that integrate with Microsoft 365/Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, Google Workspace, existing VDI, VPN and ZTNA, and endpoint and DLP tooling, and document the reference architecture for the customer's review.
Own proofs-of-concept and technical evaluations. Define success criteria with the customer up front, run the POC end to end, and turn the results into a clear business case.
Run security reviews. Lead security questionnaires, RFP and RFI technical responses, architecture reviews and compliance mapping with customer security, risk and legal teams.
Present at every level. Deliver deep technical sessions for engineers and architects, and concise value-led narratives for CISOs, CIOs and other executive sponsors.
Build the technical business case. Quantify value against incumbent approaches such as VDI, VPN and managed devices (cost, user experience, risk reduction) alongside the Account Executive.
Handle competition. Stay current on the competitive landscape and industry trends, and position Venn against VDI, DaaS, VPN, browser isolation and MDM-based approaches in secure BYOD enablement.
Raise the bar for the team. Build demo environments, POC playbooks, battlecards and reusable solution content, and mentor junior Sales Engineers.
Close the loop with Product. Bring structured customer and competitive feedback to Product and Engineering so it informs the roadmap, and make sure customers feel supported from evaluation through handoff to Customer Success.
Represent Venn externally. Speak as a subject matter expert at webinars, conferences and industry events to build awareness and thought leadership.

What You Bring

10+ years in a technical pre-sales role (Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect or similar) at a SaaS or security company, with at least 5 years selling to large enterprise and regulated customers.
A track record of leading the technical side of six- and seven-figure deals with multiple stakeholders, long cycles and formal security review.
Experience running structured POCs with defined success criteria that convert to closed-won.
Strong expertise in end-user computing, Windows environments and virtual desktop infrastructure (Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 or similar), including the limits that drive customers to look for alternatives.
Hands-on experience with identity and access: Microsoft Entra ID/Microsoft 365, Okta and Google Workspace, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, conditional access and MFA.
Solid grounding in networking and secure access: VPN, ZTNA, proxies, DNS and firewalls, and secure browsing.
Working knowledge of endpoint security (EDR/XDR, MDM/UEM), DLP and data-protection controls, and how they behave on unmanaged and contractor devices.
Fluency in compliance and regulatory frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SEC, FINRA and SOC 2, and in how to map product controls to audit requirements.
Comfort scripting and working with APIs (PowerShell, Python or similar) to build demos, automate POCs and troubleshoot in customer environments.
Credibility with technical and executive audiences alike: you can whiteboard an architecture with an engineer in the morning and defend the business case to a CISO in the afternoon.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn technical depth into clear, customer-focused value.
A consultative approach to discovery: you uncover the real problem, not just the stated requirements.
Strong ownership and judgment: you prioritize across several deals, know when to bring in Product or Engineering, and make Account Executives better.
Comfortable traveling to customer sites and events (adjust percentage to your needs).

Nice to Have

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience at a growth-stage company, where you helped build the pre-sales function, playbooks or POC process.
Industry certifications such as CISSP, Microsoft (SC-300, AZ-500, MD-102), Okta, or Citrix/VMware credentials.
Prior experience selling into financial services, healthcare or other regulated industries.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

Competitive compensation and commission opportunities
Equity at Venn
Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits
Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off
The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment, and we look for teammates who do the same.

new_jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer - Intuit Intelligence, ML & AI
new_jobs.description:
Overview

About the role

We are seeking a Distinguished Engineer to shape the technical and scientific direction of Intuit Intelligence. You will combine deep expertise in AI science and machine learning with hands-on experience building agents that solve meaningful customer problems.

You will connect research, model development, agent engineering, and production delivery across multiple organizations. Your work will establish reusable foundations for intelligent products and demonstrate where emerging AI capabilities can create durable business value. At least 40% of your time will be devoted to technical contributions, including experiments, prototypes, agent development, evaluation, and production problem-solving.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

Define the long-term AI and ML strategy, connecting scientific advances to customer needs, product opportunities, and production constraints.
Architect and build agents that reason over context, retrieve information, use tools, coordinate workflows, and complete tasks with appropriate human oversight.
Establish reusable approaches for agent orchestration, context and memory management, capability integration, and recovery from failures.
Guide model selection, adaptation, training, and inference decisions using scientific evidence and explicit tradeoffs in quality, latency, and cost.
Build evaluation systems that measure model quality, end-to-end task completion, robustness, safety, and customer value.
Establish production practices for monitoring, experimentation, model and agent lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.
Address difficult challenges in grounding, uncertainty, generalization, permissions, privacy, and reliable execution.
Develop firsthand judgment through research and implementation, advancing promising ideas from experiments into validated product capabilities.
Partner with engineering, product, design, data science, and security leaders; mentor senior technical talent and model responsible agent-driven development.

Qualifications

What you’ll bring

Deep expertise in AI science and ML, including statistical learning, deep learning, experimental design, and rigorous evaluation.
Demonstrated experience building and operating production AI systems and agents that perform consequential workflows.
Strong understanding of foundation models, retrieval, tool use, agent orchestration, and techniques for adapting models to domain needs.
The ability to distinguish improvements in model behavior from improvements in system reliability and customer outcomes.
A record of translating research into scalable products and reusable technical capabilities.
Strong software and systems engineering judgment, with the ability to influence technical direction across organizations.
The ability to explain scientific uncertainty and technical tradeoffs clearly to executive and technical audiences.

What success looks like

AI and agents complete customer tasks with measurable quality and reliability. Scientific advances translate into adopted product capabilities, reusable foundations accelerate delivery, and teams improve customer outcomes while managing operational cost and risk.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $316,000 - $427,000
